subject: Request: permission to publish BrightForge case vignette & use logo
messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>
To: Elena Moreno <elena@brightforge.com>
Date: 2027-09-14T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: permission to publish BrightForge case vignette & use logo

Hi Elena,

Thanks again for the time on Monday. Following up with the short case vignette we discussed — attached is a one-page draft that summarizes the Win-Rate improvement you saw after switching to our batching/caching configuration. We'd love to publish a brief customer spotlight on our website and social channels and include BrightForge's logo and a one-sentence quote from you.

Two asks:
- Can you review the attached draft and confirm any edits?
- Are you OK with Redwood using the BrightForge logo (attached pack) and the one-line quote? If so, can your legal or comms team sign a standard brand-release?

Target timeline: publish next Wednesday (9/22). If that works, we can route a DocuSign for a quick release once we have final text and the logo locked.

Attachments: BrightForge_case_draft_v1.pdf, logo-pack-2027.zip

Thanks — I can make edits quickly.

Best,
Irene Choi
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
irene@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0126
From: Elena Moreno <elena@brightforge.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-09-14T11:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: permission to publish BrightForge case vignette & use logo

Hi Irene,

Thanks — appreciate the concise draft. A couple of quick items from our side:
- Overall OK with the narrative, but can we soften the phrasing around '100% reduction in queue time' to 'substantial reduction in queue time (measured during peak windows)' — our internal metrics team prefers that.
- I'll need to run the attached through our comms/legal; I've attached BrightForge Brand Guidelines and the high-res logo pack our marketing prefers.
- We also need to confirm usage duration: BrightForge typically limits logo use to 24 months unless we agree otherwise. Is that acceptable?

I'll loop in our legal if they want to sign, but if you can send a standard one-page release, that will speed things up. Timeline: we'll try to get back by Thursday EOD.

Elena
Elena Moreno
Head of Marketing, BrightForge
elena@brightforge.com | +1 212-555-0189

Attachment: brightforge_brand_guidelines.pdf
From: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-09-14T12:20:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Request: permission to publish BrightForge case vignette & use logo

Vanessa / Laura — FYI and request for quick signoff. BrightForge (Elena) is comfortable in principle but asked to soften one phrase and confirmed they limit logo usage to 24 months. They attached their brand guidelines and logo pack.

What we need from comms/legal:
- Marketing: confirm the positioned quote and suggested hero layout are OK. Elena suggested the more conservative metrics language above. Also propose a recommended alt-text/caption for the logo.
- Legal: can you prepare the standard one-page brand release (non-exclusive, 24-month term) and confirm any required redlines? If it's ready I can route DocuSign to Elena.

Timeline: Elena expects an answer by Thursday EOD; would be great to publish next Wed (9/22) if we can get the release executed.

I attached the draft and the files Elena sent.

Thanks — Irene

(Original message below)

---
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-09-14T14:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: permission to publish BrightForge case vignette & use logo

Thanks for the ping, Irene. Marketing review notes:
- Tone: good; accept Elena's adjustment to the metric wording. We'll change the sentence to: 'substantial reduction in queue time (observed during peak windows)'.
- Logo usage: OK for website/linked social posts. Please include the following caption: 'BrightForge (logo) — Customer since 2026'.
- Usage duration of 24 months is acceptable; we can consider extension at renewal.
- Please use the high-res SVG in the pack and follow their spacing rules (guidelines attached).

Laura — from marketing side this is straightforward; will defer to legal on release language.

Vanessa Ortiz
Head of Marketing Operations | Redwood Inference
vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>, Elena Moreno <elena@brightforge.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-09-16T15:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: permission to publish BrightForge case vignette & use logo — release and DocuSign

Hi all,

Thanks for the context. I've drafted Redwood's standard brand/logo release with the terms discussed: non-exclusive, use for marketing materials (web, social, PR), 24-month term, attribution language, no endorsement implication, and indemnity/representations limited to fact statements in the case vignette.

Elena — I can send this by DocuSign for an e-signature. If your legal prefers redlines, please flag them in the DocuSign review. If you'd like a tracked PDF first, let me know.

Summary of key points (from the release):
- Grant: BrightForge grants Redwood a non-exclusive license to use the BrightForge name and logos for the specified materials for 24 months.
- Quote/Attribution: Redwood will use the one-line quote as provided; any material changes to the quote will be shared for approval.
- No exclusivity or testimonial endorsement beyond the selected materials.
- Governing law: California; no fee for the release.

I've attached 'BrightForge_brand_release_v1.pdf' (one-page) and will prepare DocuSign link once I hear back. Irene — I will route DocuSign to Elena and cc the marketing contact.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel | Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.com

Attachment: BrightForge_brand_release_v1.pdf
